current.text: Josh Green plays for Utah. The summer notes about his trade to Minnesota and a possible starting role there no longer apply to his current team.
Utah's projected starting lineup is Keyonte George, Darryn Peterson, Lauri Markkanen, Jaren Jackson Jr. and Jusuf Nurkic. Green is not in it.
Utah has a crowded and deeper roster at guard and wing, with George, Peterson, Sensabaugh, Bailey and Markkanen, plus new wing Josh Okogie.
Experts expect Utah to try to win this season, so a tanking team's late-season minutes for bench players will not be there.
He is not a draft target in our 12-team league. Both sites value him at 0 USD and rank him far outside the 144 players drafted.

durable.text: Experts see him as a connective wing who adds size, not a strong player.
He scores very little. His projected points are far below the top 250 pool.
